# SEO-518: Nominate one address when a document duplicates a page

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Domain | `documents` |
| Category | `TECHNICAL_SEO` |

| Confidence | `HIGH` |

## Statement

Where the same material exists as both a web page and a downloadable file, one of the two is nominated as the version to index and the other declares that nomination through a link header.

## Rationale

Leaving both versions unnominated lets the platform choose, and it frequently chooses the file, so readers arriving from search get a download instead of the page the site maintains.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site",
    "public_documents"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Prefer the page as the nominated version where one exists, since it can carry navigation and be corrected in place, and emit the header from the route that serves the file.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Identify page and document pairs covering the same material and confirm the served link header on the file names the nominated address.
- Evidence: `HTTP_HEADER`, `FILE`, `RENDERED_HTML`
- Automated check: none.

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `GOOGLE_SEARCH`, `BING_SEARCH`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: none recorded.
